Swiss Interior Design
Advertiser: Swiss Interior
Started: 28 Apr 2026
Take a peek into Nic's day as an Interior Designer, the
routine, the work, and what keeps him going. Every home he
designs starts with a real conversation. Because good design
isn't just about how the home looks, it's about how the design
works for the homeowners living in it. What Nic loves most is
getting to know the people behind each project, because once
you understand how someone lives day to day, everything just
clicks into place. This is one of 3,000+ homes we've
transformed across Singapore. And in 12+ years, not a single
one looks the same. Every space is designed around the people
living in it, down to the last detail. And the job doesn't
stop when the renovation does. Every home we design comes with
after-sales support, so you're taken care of long after
move-in day. If you're thinking about renovating and don't
know where to start, book a free consultation with our team
today via the form below 👇
Open the ad link to inspect the live creative.
